content:
A job listing from Apple seems to suggest the company might be planning to launch some live versions of Apple Fitness+ classes. However, I have strong doubts that things are as they appear.

The position is for a studio producer, and Apple explicitly requires candidates to have extensive live production experience, as well as a "genuine curiosity about the future direction of live content"…

MacRumors spotted the listing weeks after it was posted, and there are indeed quite a few mentions of "live" in it.

Apple Fitness+ is hiring a Producer with solid live or live-to-tape experience, and a genuine curiosity about the future direction of live content. We're looking for a creative collaborator excited to experiment with new forms, push the possibilities of live fitness content, and help shape the next generation of the Fitness+ experience—while building and maintaining a fluid, ever-changing schedule to match the rhythm of a live production environment. If you thrive in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment and want to join an innovative, collaborative group redefining live production at Apple, this is your chance.

Some of the required qualifications also echo this.

  • Equally comfortable in live production and post-production, able to transition seamlessly between the two
  • Must be able to adapt to control room, office environment, and live event settings

However, it's hard to see what advantage a live version of Fitness+ classes would have over the pre-recorded version. Even Apple's own keynotes have been pre-recorded since the pandemic, and while some may miss the excitement of a live broadcast, most people seem to agree that this approach delivers a better experience.

At most, I could imagine some real-time events for special occasions, but I still expect the actual fitness classes to be pre-recorded. I think the biggest clue is the phrase "the rhythm of a live production environment," along with the acceptance of live-to-tape experience. I believe Apple wants even the pre-recorded classes to have that thrilling sense of live energy.

What do you think? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
